== Summary ==
Slip “•Red 12” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-P.pdf Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)] (PDF file created 12 December 2022), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 1089, 1624, 1811)). Version [[Red 12 (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
